topic: student-led anti-Bolsonaro march ahead of the 25 October presidential runoff, defending public education and democracy
scale: thousands of students in downtown Rio de Janeiro
quote1: Thousands of people have marched in downtown Rio de Janeiro in a student protest against presidential election favorite Flavio Bolsonaro and the prospect of the far-right's return to power in Brazil, as the campaign for a runoff election swung into action.
quote2: Thousands of Brazilian students marched in downtown Rio de Janeiro on Wednesday to protest against the possibility of Flávio Bolsonaro winning the presidency, after the far-right candidate received more votes than incumbent and left-leaning Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the first round of Brazil’s presidential election.
